summary: Phase 6 Personal Track + P0 admin endpoint validation. Backend 9/9 pytest passed (set-track valid/invalid, /me reflects track, created-at-health, backfill idempotent, pending-downgrades, sweep-now). Frontend end-to-end flow verified: login -> /choose-track (both cards visible) -> Personal card -> /build (prompt + submit + 5 chips) -> chip click populates prompt -> Build submit -> /build/:draftId (draft-review-page, 13 file-tree nodes, lucide icons, 0 emojis, Regenerate + Ship visible) -> Ship click -> /build/:draftId/ship (4 progress-step-items). Materialize returned expected 503 (SUPABASE_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN absent) and UI showed graceful failure fallback. Policy pages /refund-policy and /acceptable-use render amber DRAFT banner correctly (verified visually). /dashboard still renders (developer track regression clean).

ui_bugs.issue: Line 463 uses CommonJS `require("react-router-dom").useNavigate()` inside a Vite/ESM module. Throws `require is not defined` at runtime. TrackSwitcher component crashes; [data-testid='settings-track-switcher'] and 'settings-switch-mode-button' never render. Fix: replace with a top-of-file `import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'` and use `const nav = useNavigate()`.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx line 463: replace `require("react-router-dom").useNavigate()` with proper ESM import + hook usage. This is the only functional bug blocking Phase 6 acceptance.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx: mixing CommonJS require() inside a Vite/ESM React component is a fatal anti-pattern; component throws on render. Should be caught by ESLint no-undef rule.
PolicyPage rendering relies on client-side markdown fetch; DRAFT banner visible confirms this works, but consider SSR/prerender for policy SEO in future iterations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes Settings.jsx require() bug, retest /settings TrackSwitcher: expect [data-testid='settings-track-switcher'] to render, [data-testid='settings-switch-mode-button'] to open [data-testid='track-switch-confirm-modal'], and confirm to call POST /api/aurem-dev/auth/set-track then navigate to /build (if switching to personal) or /dashboard (if switching to developer). All other flows are green. Note: materialize returns 503 in preview because SUPABASE_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN is unset -- that's expected per problem statement; do not treat as a bug. Draft-review flow up to Ship click all works with heuristic scaffolder. Signup->/choose-track redirect was not directly re-tested (existing user logs into /dashboard); if that flow is needed, use a new signup with fresh email.
rca of the issue: Settings.jsx line 463: `const nav = require("react-router-dom").useNavigate();`. Vite runs the file as native ESM in the browser; there is no CommonJS `require` global, so evaluating this line throws ReferenceError, React error boundary triggers, and the whole TrackSwitcher subtree unmounts with the error `require is not defined`. Fix by adding `import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';` at the top of Settings.jsx (or reuse existing imports if present) and replacing line 463 with `const nav = useNavigate();`.
